name: classification-expired-emails
subject: Your investor category needs updating
previewText: Update your investor category to keep investing in companies

fields.heading: Your investor categorisation has expired
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

Every 12 months we ask you to confirm your investor category with Abundance. You don’t need to do this immediately, but you will need to confirm your category before you next invest in company investments on Abundance.
